contract.from: owned removal attempted; registry comparison/readback pending
contract.event: Git registry read or physical identity observation unavailable
contract.guard: stillRegistered returns null: nonzero list result, canonicalization EACCES/EIO/other failure, or no successful physical-ancestor observation
contract.effects: Return ok:false at the current attempt with bounded registration-unavailable diagnostic. Unknown never authorizes subsequent prune/removal or a false absence claim. A prior proven registered+genuine-absent observation may already have authorized one prune before readback becomes unknown.
contract.failure_retry: Stop this cleanup attempt without another destructive retry; preserve unresolved ownership and independent work/receipt outcomes. No author invocation or schema/API change.

transitions.component_scope: Farm registration/owned-path identity; real local Windows Git/junction controls and injected observation failures, not a real unmount or cross-platform qualification.
transitions.rationale: Analytical edge for the new internal null/physical-ancestor guard. It complements the existing filesystem-unknown refusal; it does not add a runtime operation, native/public schema, workflow or authority.
